paragraphs.source_en: On the fifth day of the sixth month, the naval forces were again defeated by Yi Sun-sin at Danghangpo, losing many warships, and the naval commander Kurushima Michiyuki was killed in battle. From Nagoya, he submitted a memorial to the emperor: “The imperial court is to be transferred to the Great Ming the year after next; I therefore ask that His Majesty begin preparations without delay.”
